title: Vegetarian Malaysian-Style Soup
description: A flavorful and comforting soup inspired by Malaysian cuisine, perfect for a chilly evening. This recipe is a delicious and satisfying vegetarian option.
instructions: Heat the vegetable broth in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the peanut sauce, carrots, potatoes, onions, and garlic to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the whipped coconut cream and spinach. Cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with additional peanut sauce and coconut cream if desired.
